en: Play the F chord, not the B chord, in measure 12.
Slow down to 60 BPM and count the beats out loud.
Don't press the third string so hard.
Your tempo is fine — keep 120 BPM.
Switch from C major to A minor in the chorus.
Mute the strings with your left hand, not your right hand.
Sing the melody one octave higher in the bridge.
The second beat of bar 3 comes late.
Use a capo on the second fret.
Do not stop before the bridge.
Strumming here, fingerpicking in the verse.
